For the Australian dollar and commodity currencies, the read is mixed: firm producer prices reflect cost pressure rather than a demand-led recovery in China’s appetite for raw materials. Downing Street says the prime minister will personally write to councils on Armistice Day to urge them to draw up plans. No one who served in the UK armed forces should have to sleep on the streets this Christmas, Andy Burnham has said. Downing Street said the prime minister will personally write to councils across England on Armistice Day (11 November) to urge them to draw up specific plans to offer accommodation for veterans sleeping rough ahead of the festive period. He will say that, going forward, national and local government should work under the "simple principle" that "no one who has served our country should ever be left to sleep rough on our streets".

Nintendo has released its remake of what is considered one of the best games ever made - the BBC's Tom Gerken gives his verdict. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time was finally released on Thursday, after years of rumours that Nintendo would remake the game - considered one of the best ever made. URI’s newcomers shined, six Rams hit double figures and Archie Miller’s team responded in its first taste of adversity in a 84-66 win over Monmouth. Monmouth trimmed a double-digit deficit to nine points midway through the second half, but Rhode Island answered the bell in emphatic fashion on its way to an 84-66 win in the Hall of Fame Tip-Off. Luter, a 5-foot-11, 203-pounder from Indianapolis, Ind., replaced Army starter Cale Hellums after the Black Knights , trailing 17-7, was ineffective. He hit a hole on the right side for 5 yards but was stopped just short from the 2. Hellums stepped back in and got the touchdown on the dive, cutting the margin to 17-14 with 6:07 left.

Smith, the best wideout in college football and a generational talent, is part of a descending Ohio State team that has just lost back-to-back games. After losing quarterback Julian Sayin to injury (possibly for the rest of the year), the team has started a slide that may send it out of the College Football Playoff picture. When the Saints host the Browns on Sunday, New Orleans defensive end Cam Jordan will reach a rare milestone. The Week 9 game will be Jordan's 250th. Via NBC Sports research, Jordan will become only the third defensive player in NFL history to play 250 or more games with the same team. The others are Darrell Green, who played 295 games for Washington from 1983 through 2002, and Jim Marshall, who played 270 games for the Vikings from 1961 through 1979. Jordan, the son of former Vikings tight end Steve Jordan, was a first-round pick in 2011. His dad played in 176 games from 1982 through 1994.

In response to Cooper Flagg being mentioned as the future face of the NBA, Villanueva countered - and then doubled down. The University of New Hampshire football team rallied in the final seconds to beat Rhode Island, 24-21. With UNH trailing 21-17 and 1:53 remaining, McLeish engineered an 11-play, 64-yard drive capped by a 1-yard touchdown pass to tight end Colby Ramshaw with 7 seconds remaining, giving the Wildcats a 24-21 lead. 'Like waking up on Christmas morning': Hawks complete championship run with victory in WIAA D2 state girls volleyball title match. The Hawks (31-11) beat Kettle Moraine Lutheran 25-21, 25-18, 20-25, 27-25 to capture their third title in program history, all coming in the last five years. Bella Daley had 12 kills and Kayla Fournillier added 10 to lead a balanced Hawks attack. Raya Zurfluh had 36 assists and Hope Kaufman and Rose Kendall had 15 and 14 digs, respectively. Lily Renz added four aces. Daley was in the Resch Center stands when the Hawks, led by her older sister Madison, captured back-to-back titles in 2022 and 2023.

Oregon football rode the momentum from a first-half fake punt to dominate Ohio State in Columbus. A season that seemed destined in the preseason for greatness was over before November. Fans were booing the Ducks ' offense, calling for heads to roll and fifth-year coach Dan Lanning had to figure out how to solve all of Oregon's issues while facing tough questions in his media appearances . A 41-28 win against Ohio State Nov. 7 in front of over 100,000 at Ohio Stadium was entirely different, to say the least. "Our goal was to quiet them down," Lanning said. "Then obviously in the fourth quarter, they weren't there anymore."

Angel Reese will never stop being trolled from her own celebration. Just before LSU fell, 31-13 to Alabama at Tiger Stadium, Reese was seen hanging out with her fellow LSU alumni, Shaquille O'Neal , and that's when he continued, what's been a recent tradition of trolling the former National Champion. Woodmont girls volleyball coach Haleigh Horgan's father died before the season started. Her team rallied around her and claimed its second state title. Cray Wanderers host Stockport County in the FA Cup first round, with 112 league places separating the two sides. If at first you do not succeed, try and try again. And again. Until, at the 78th attempt, you finally make it. Formed in 1860, Cray Wanderers are one of the oldest football clubs in the world - and the oldest club in London still in existence. Voters sent National and Labour a clear message last night – and the parties have no one to blame but themselves New Zealand voters sent the two major parties a clear message last night. They expect more. In a resounding rejection of the incrementalist political managerialism that has characterised the governments led by the major parties over the past decades, seven in 10 voters passed over Labour, and the same number skipped National. Between them, the two parties took just over half the party vote , 58% on election night. It was the lowest combined major party vote ever.

From there, Payne had the pace to build a gap and he did, until 'ADP' cleared traffic and closed over the final laps. Each team is assigned a rating that measures its true strength on a net-points scale, as well as its expected point margin against an average opponent on a neutral field. Trade talks between franchises cannot legally begin until that signed form reaches the BCCI. A player who consents cannot then pick his destination, as the selling franchise chooses the bid. Yes. The consent form sits at the centre of every IPL trade, and a player who declines to sign it cannot be moved, regardless of what the two franchises have agreed between themselves.

The government says pupils in Year 7 to 9 should have "richer, more engaging" learning than preparing for GCSEs. Secondary schools will be told not to teach GCSEs early as part of a major shake-up of how children in Years 7 to 9 are taught. The government plans to make Key Stage 3 a more distinct education phase, urging schools to focus less on exams and more on a "richer, more engaging" experience. The changes come in response to two reviews that found pupils were increasingly becoming disengaged in their early teenage years, affecting attendance and achievement, the Department for Education (DfE) said.

What a great play by Broncos safety Devon Key against the Panthers! On 3rd-and-8 with 1:45 to play, Colts coach Shane Steichen called a pass instead of running clock before a field goal attempt. Why that was the right call Facing a third-and-8 at the Dallas 32-yard line with 1:45 left in Sunday's game, Steichen called a pass play in order to try to get the first down instead of handing it off in an effort to run clock. The Cowboys had just used their final timeout, Indianapolis had one down left at its disposal and Steichen knew Dallas would have enough time to drive into range for a game-tying field goal even if he ran off an extra 40 seconds in that situation.

If you've ever noticed plumes of heavy smoke emanating from an F1 car it might be something cold rather than something hot — here's how F1 teams use dry ice. Dry ice is carbon dioxide in solid form, sitting at a bone-chilling -109.3 degrees Fahrenheit. It doesn't melt into liquid like ice water — instead, it sublimates directly into gas, which makes it perfect for cooling high-performance components without leaving behind any moisture. That's key when you're dealing with tightly packaged electronics, batteries, and driver cockpits that are not water-friendly.

An 8-year-old Haitian boy who lost Temporary Protected Status earlier this year was taken into federal custody during an immigration check-in. Med spas are raving about vitamin B12 shots as a pick-me-up. But do they actually make you feel more energized? I f you spend time on social media, you may have seen med spa owners and employees describing vitamin B12 shots as a pick-me-up . When they’re run down or facing a busy week, they say, a quick injection gets them through. Some med spas say many people feel an energy lift within a day or two and recommend a shot every few weeks. B12 is essential to your health, and people who don’t get enough of it can feel exhausted or worse. But most people already have plenty of B12, and for them, extra doses aren’t likely to help.

New figures suggest hazel dormice may be recovering after decades of decline, with warmer summers boosting survival. Dormouse numbers may be recovering in England and Wales after years of decline, offering a rare piece of good news for one of our best-loved mammals. The animal has disappeared from much of the countryside with conservationists warning of a long-term collapse in its population. However, new data suggests dormouse numbers increased between 2020-2025, a period that coincided with warmer springs and summers.

The education secretary says she is backing the inquiry to "get to the heart of the barriers holding children back". Action from "across society" is needed to help improve the educational outcomes of white working-class children, the co-chair of an independent inquiry looking into the issue has said. The inquiry's first report, published this summer , concluded that once-in-a-generation reforms were needed to fix a system "not serving the interests of white working-class children". The next phase will focus on early years children and teenagers aged 14 to 19, aiming for a stronger start at primary school and improving older students' routes through education into successful careers.
